'''Soris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Moa Bounty Hunter after mesa for mysa veiws polictica. Makea himsa deada. Soris isa hisa namea.|Nalskel, to a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]|<ref name="SWG:SGN" />}}
[[File:SorisCamp.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Soris' camp.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Soris was recruited by [[Borvo]] the Hutt in order to eliminate the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] [[Nalskel]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Nevertheless, Nalskel seek help and contacted the famous bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Fett thus sent a novice bounty hunter to resolve the politician's problem. The bounty hunter visited Soris' camp outside of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kaadara]] and found a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] which contained information regarding Soris' allegiance with [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|Borvo's criminal empire]]. The bounty hunter therefore attacked one of Borvo's camp near Kaadara and eliminated several criminals. The bounty hunter finally entered the camp and met Soris himself. After the bounty hunter gave him his [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] from Nalskel, Soris attempted to defend himself but he was killed by the bounty hunter.<ref name="SWG:SGN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Soris was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SGN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Soris was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
